name: sap-monitoring-system
description: SAP Basis landscape health dashboard — Node.js + Express + PostgreSQL API with a React front end.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run import
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run worker --workspace server"
